title: TikTok go-live operator script (warmup complete → post workflow)
rationale: TikTok warmup completes 2026-03-27. Operator needs a single command to: (1) confirm warmup is done, (2) see top-scored pending videos with file paths, (3) mark a video as posted. Built as scripts/scs001/go-live.ts. Follows CLAUDE.md rule 7: manual posting is default, API is SPOF. Script shows operator exactly which files to upload and marks them done in post-queue.jsonl.
success_criteria: go-live.ts exits 1 with WARMUP PENDING when days < 3
go-live.ts exits 0 with READY TO POST when days >= 3
go-live.ts shows top 5 pending videos sorted by score desc
--mark-posted VIDEO_ID marks entry status=posted in post-queue.jsonl
File-not-found warning shown for missing video files

tasks.description: Create scripts/scs001/go-live.ts: operator tool that checks warmup, lists top pending videos, and marks videos as posted
